# Launchy Image Converter

> Launchy's in-browser image converter. It turns JPG, PNG, HEIC and other images into WebP files, or traces logos into SVG vectors, with SEO alt text, clean file names and ready-made HTML. Images never leave the browser.

## Pages

- [Home](https://launchy-img-converter.vercel.app/): Upload images, pick WebP or SVG, set quality, add alt text, then download each file or all of them as a ZIP.
